messages:
sylvie: Quick pulse — rewrap sweep started at 03:20 UTC, ~1.2M envelopes, currently 38% complete. We're seeing spikes of KMS Throttling (AWS & Azure) and a handful of GCP IAM permission errors. Need proposals for telemetry, backoff, and audit events.

raj: Can you paste the throttling signature? is it 400 with Retry-After or 429?

sylvie: Mostly 400/ThrottlingException from AWS with x-amzn-RequestId + occasional 429 from Azure Key Vault. GCP is returning PERMISSION_DENIED for about 120 envelopes (probably missing roles).

kevin: Copy. Two quick items: 1) add a per-KMS rate-meter and expose it to the console so engs can see KPS per-region, 2) DLQ visibility — we should tag envelopes with rewrap_attempt and last_error_code.

maria: For audit logs: include original_key_id, target_key_id, envelope_id, wrap_status, and calling_principal. Make sure we don't log plaintext or materialized keys. Also include a correlation_id for the sweep job.

raj: +1. For throttling strategy I propose: exponential backoff with jitter, but bounded by job window and a circuit-breaker per-customer and per-key to avoid hot-key storms. Example config: 
```json
{"initial_delay_ms":200,"max_delay_ms":60000,"factor":2.0,"jitter":0.25,"max_attempts":8}
```

tara: FYI, RBAC change for the rewrap service account went out yesterday — it now has kms:Encrypt, kms:ReEncrypt* for AWS and roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for GCP. We should add a check to fail-fast on permission errors and route those envelopes to a perm-failure DLQ.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rewrap-worker v2.4 deployed to prod at 03:12 UTC on arn:aws:ecs:cluster/rewrap-prod.

kevin: On error recovery: use idempotent requeue tokens. If a wrap attempt fails transiently, requeue with incremented attempt counter and next_backoff_ms calculated from config. After max_attempts -> move to customer-visible DLQ and emit security/audit event with failure_reason.

maria: Audit event schema suggestion: 
`event_type: envelope_rewrap_attempt`, 
`meta: {env_id, orig_kid, target_kid, attempt, status, error_code, principal}`

raj: Also add metrics: rewrap_success_rate, rewrap_throttle_rate, rewrap_perm_failure_rate, avg_rewrap_latency, outstanding_rewrap_workers. Plot by customer and by key. Dashboards + alert if throttle_rate > 0.5% for 5m.

sylvie: Good. Two follow-ups: 1) raj — can you wire up per-kms meters + alert and a quick console panel? 2) tara — confirm DLQ naming + RBAC fail-fast semantics. I can own an RFC for the audit schema and DLQ lifecycle.

tara: I'll confirm DLQ naming and update the helm chart. DLQ prefix will be `rewrap-dlq/{region}/{env}` and perm-failures go to `rewrap-dlq/{region}/{env}/perm`.

raj: I'll stub the meters and a minimal Grafana panel, ETA 6h.

kevin: I'll implement idempotent token + backoff logic in worker, plus audit emit hooks. ETA EOD.

maria: I'll draft the audit RFC and share in #eng-security review. Include retention policy (7y for rotation traceability) and redact rules.

sylvie: Great — if we can land meters + backoff + DLQ wiring today we can throttle the sweep to 50% pace and avoid KMS limits. Will post a quick runbook for on-call when we flip the throttle. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: alert: rewrap-throttle-alert suppressed (manual throttle applied) at 03:35 UTC by sylvie.

sylvie: Next check-in in 30m unless anyone sees a showstopper. Thanks everyone.
